items.title: GIC Re reports 9.7% profit jump to Rs 1,922 crore driven by improved claims and underwriting
items.description: General Insurance Corporation of India has announced a notable profit increase of 9.7 percent, attributed to enhanced performance in claims management and underwriting. The company reported an 8.8 percent year-on-year rise in gross premium income. Furthermore, the incurred claims ratio saw a significant enhancement, reflecting improved cost efficiency, while GIC Re’s combined ratio also indicated lower underwriting losses, showcasing overall financial robustness.

items.title: Natco Pharma Q1 profit falls 57 pc to Rs 206.5 cr
items.description: Natco Pharma has reported a stark profit decline in the first quarter, largely driven by reduced sales of its leading cancer drug, lenalidomide. This led to a pronounced drop in consolidated revenues compared to the prior year. On a brighter note, the core business showed some positive growth, and total expenses saw a decrease, providing a silver lining to the financial report.

items.title: Awfis Space Solutions Q1 profit jumps over 2-fold YoY to Rs 24cr, revenue rises to Rs 449cr
items.description: Awfis Space Solutions has announced a remarkable uptick in its financial performance for the June quarter, with consolidated net profit skyrocketing to Rs 23.93 crore, more than double compared to the previous year. During the same timeframe, total income surged to Rs 448.87 crore. Operating 251 coworking centres across eighteen cities, the company boasts a robust portfolio occupancy rate of seventy-six percent.

items.title: Ashok Leyland Q1 profit rises 2% as revenue jumps 10% to Rs 10,750 crore
items.description: Ashok Leyland reported a 2% rise in consolidated Q1FY27 profit to ₹668 crore, while revenue grew 10% to ₹10,750 crore. Record commercial vehicle sales supported performance, though rising material costs pressured margins, prompting cost-saving and pricing initiatives.
